aggregation: values = mean of 3 coders; coder_sd = sample SD (n-1) across coders; flagged_axes = axes with coder_sd > 1.0

axis_definitions.burst: Damage deliverable in about 2 s (combos, empowered attacks, executes, percent-health damage).
axis_definitions.early_vs_late: Power timing from mechanics only: -2 early (high base, no scaling) to +2 late (quests, stacking, high-level gates).
axis_definitions.global_presence: Acting across the map (global teleports, map-wide abilities or vision, remote soaking, fast travel).
axis_definitions.hard_cc: Stun, root, silence, sleep, polymorph, fear, taunt, time stop, knock-up, knockback, pull, grab.
axis_definitions.healing_throughput: Healing and shields given to allies.
axis_definitions.mobility: Dashes, blinks, teleports, leaps, flight, speed boosts, unstoppable movement, repositioning stealth.
axis_definitions.range: Distance from which most damage and effects are applied (0 melee, 4 very long range).
axis_definitions.self_sustain_shields: Self-healing, lifesteal, self-shields, armor, damage reduction, self invulnerability, extra lives.
axis_definitions.siege: Damaging and pressuring structures (pushing summons, out-ranging towers, structure bonuses, disables).
axis_definitions.soft_cc_peel: Slows, blinds, attack-speed reductions, area denial, and ally-protection tools that are not healing (cleanse, unstoppable or invulnerability on an ally, moving allies, displacing attackers).
axis_definitions.sustained_damage: Damage per second kept up over about 10 s (basic attack DPS, repeatable abilities, DoTs, summons).
axis_definitions.waveclear: Speed of killing minion waves (area, piercing, bonus vs non-heroes, minion-fighting summons).

identity_note: Per-hero identity = sum(weight * mean axis value). Team identity = mean over its five heroes. Fixed, never fit.
